description: This file declares the LocalStore class, which implements the ILocalStore interface for managing local data storage using SQLite. It includes method declarations for opening the database, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding entries. It also contains private helper functions and member variables for database connection management.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: Implements local data storage operations using SQLite, providing methods to open database, create tables, manage entries, and set limits.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database connection at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table within a specified range.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves entries from a table starting at a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query string to retrieve events from a table.
